summary: Gone 1931 crow's nest in the Coeur d'Alene area; sources disagree on county and status; a November 2024 Idaho Fire Lookouts visit found nothing on the western hilltop.

facts.status_note: Abandoned per firelookout.com and the Idaho lookout list; destroyed or removed per Idaho Fire Lookouts, no date; a November 2024 visit found nothing on the western hilltop

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site hike-in; the writers climbed from a parked car

events.note: Crow's nest, per firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts
Idaho Fire Lookouts post dated November 9, 2024: the western hilltop had no trees and nothing there; posts with #9 wire and old insulator loops were seen along the forest road

evidence.supports: 1931 crow's nest history on Idaho Fire Lookouts

evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.
From where we parked the car it was a leisurely climb up the hill to the west, but there is absolutely nothing there.
The hilltop is entirely devoid of trees, and it appears to have been for some time.

evidence.supports: any crow's nest long gone, western hilltop
evidence.quote: Any crow’s nest is long gone.

evidence.supports: posts with #9 wire and insulator loops off the forest road
evidence.quote: After we left and were driving back down the forest service road, we did see some trees and posts set off the road, that had #9 wire on them and / or old insulator loops.

evidence.supports: eastern hilltop not thought to be the site
evidence.quote: There were more trees on the hilltop to the east, so we didn't think that was the location

evidence.supports: Idaho Panhandle National Forest named on Idaho Fire Lookouts
listed under a Bonner County heading
Coeur d'Alene National Forest on Forest Lookouts page
Crowsnest type, Abandoned, Shoshone County on the Idaho list

corrections.why: Every source read calls it a crow's nest (the Idaho list type is Crowsnest); none describes a platform.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and the Idaho lookout list say Shoshone County; Forest Lookouts lists it under a Bonner County heading. The story reports both.
firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts say Coeur d'Alene National Forest; Idaho Fire Lookouts names the Idaho Panhandle National Forest. This record uses the Coeur d'Alene name.
Abandoned on firelookout.com and the Idaho lookout list; destroyed or removed on Idaho Fire Lookouts, with no date. The record keeps gone and reports both.

notes_for_editor: The brief holds two coordinate points for this site. The Forest Fire Lookout Association list gives 47.98506, -116.34007; the other point, 47.9684, -116.28799, is not in any page read, so it is unverified. The November 2024 visit post is the only account of the site today. The build year rests on one-line entries.
